cases.disposition_reason: With motion paused, Run leaves every task queued, writes one Pipeline started line, sets the title to Pipeline · running, and the meta to 0 of 6 done. A second Run adds nothing. Cancel opens Cancel pipeline? with Keep running and Cancel pipeline. Keep running leaves that start frame. Confirming cancel writes Pipeline cancelled by user, sets status Cancelled, retitles the panel Pipeline, and marks the tasks cancelled.
cases.action_sequence: Select targets and run the pipeline. Watch stage, log, and progress. Refuse cancellation, then confirm it, then restart.
cases.expected_results: The running stage identity changes. Confirmed cancel stops that run. Restart starts one new run.
cases.forbidden_effects: An unconfirmed cancel stops the pipeline.
